title: File lookup experiment
description: A real, deliberately tiny file-lookup fixture for learning the toolkit. These timings are not application performance claims.

metrics.label: p95 latency
metrics.description: Wall time in milliseconds of each in-process file lookup, including validation; p95 interpolated over raw compatible requests within each repeat. Process startup is outside the timer.

metrics.label: File reads / request
metrics.description: Application-instrumented read_text calls per request, not kernel syscalls. Each request is one raw observation.

metrics.label: Peak allocated memory
metrics.description: Python tracemalloc peak megabytes per case. A guardrail for this tiny fixture, not process RSS.

metrics.label: Incorrect results
metrics.description: A raw 0/1 correctness indicator per lookup; mean is an error fraction from 0 to 1.
